name: broadside-functions
description: Cloud Functions backend for Broadside (server-validated naval combat game)

scripts.sim: SIM_GAMES=${SIM_GAMES:-1000} SIM_SEED=${SIM_SEED:-12345} sh -c 'parse_sim_args() { for arg do case "$arg" in --modes=*) SIM_MODES=${arg#--modes=};; esac; done; export SIM_MODES; vitest run src/game/core/sim.test.ts; }; parse_sim_args "$@"' --
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-broadside --only auth,firestore "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.mts"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth
